description: Single-DGX-Spark Qwen3.8-27B on Ash Hart's TensorFold engine v0.6.6 (exact decoding, custom CUDA kernels JIT-compiled on first start, stock upstream source) with turboderp's EXL3 3.00 bits-per-weight pack (branch 3.00bpw, 13.8 GB) and z-lab's DFlash2 draft model, which TensorFold's CUDA engine requires unless drafting is switched off. TensorFold marks its EXL3 path experimental: replies are exact against the same engine, prompts prefill about half as fast as the MLX 4-bit checkpoint, and it runs on one GPU only. One rank only: the platform harness has no distributed support. Serves one request at a time by default (upstream CUDA default; the concurrency setting enables shared rounds) at the model's 262,144-token window. Text only: upstream documents no image input on EXL3 packs. Upstream measured on one DGX Spark: 83 tok/s code sampled and 44 tok/s chat sampled (MLX 4-bit checkpoint: 58 and 50), 13.2 GiB after loading and a 28 GiB peak on a 64k prompt (upstream claims, unmeasured here); the memory envelope below extrapolates upstream's 62.5 GiB startup estimate for the 262,144-token window and is unmeasured. Only the 3.00bpw branch is measured upstream; other branches (for example 4.00bpw) are different weights and would be a different recipe. Licences, for information: Qwen3.8-27B and turboderp's EXL3 pack are Apache-2.0; z-lab/Qwen3.8-27B-DFlash2 states Apache-2.0 on its model card (a mirror of incoai/Qwen3.8-27B-DFlash2); TensorFold is Apache-2.0 from 0.6.0 (MIT up to 0.5.0). TensorFold v0.6.6 at cb2ebf0540f42604e2759b2ddef497861e928248, the newest release of TensorFold's Python engine line (0.6; TensorFold 1.x is a native binary that serves only Nemotron on CUDA), keeps every option this recipe passes. Per upstream's release notes it runs CUDA prompts at bf16 by default and serves Prometheus /metrics (opt-in --prefill-fp8 and --checkpoint-slots exist but are not exposed here); the existing context bound, KV/drafting defaults, and one-stream resource profile are retained. From 0.6.1 to 0.6.6 upstream's release notes add, among others, the Anthropic Messages API (/v1/messages), optional API keys (not set here), /v1/decisions scoring and joint prefill of prompts that wait together when concurrency is above 1. The pinned ARM64 image includes xgrammar 0.2.8 and Apache TVM FFI 0.1.11 for OpenAI response_format structured-output requests. Thinking is chosen per request (chat template kwargs or sampling parameters), not as a recipe option; server default: Open a think block by default (upstream default: --thinking).
title: Qwen3.8 27B EXL3 3.00bpw TensorFold single Spark
